name: Nocturnal Oversight
pitch_50: Nocturnal is an open longitudinal public-memory system that keeps source-linked events, corrections, disputes and later outcomes attached to the matters they change, so a reader can understand the current documented state and then inspect how that state evolved without turning the interface into a truth or reputation score.
description: Nocturnal is portfolio-complete on canonical main. Its human-facing product has three depths over one public-safe backend: Now for continuous readable journalism, Read for sustained matter histories with What Changed?, chronology, evidence and historical as-of views, and Research for read-only Timeline, Before/After comparison, Subjects, Sources and Evidence inspection. The hardened runtime preserves append-only longitudinal state, source provenance, corrections/disputes, public/intake/operator authority separation, portable snapshots and deterministic verification. The canonical public-product integration is 12ece15ec6042dec786ef50006db2f92251a7840 and the portfolio freeze status is ceb0551e0c148476c51b40b8ffef1713f33efd55.
limitations: No external newsroom, institutional or broad user adoption is claimed. No externally demonstrated workflow improvement, legal readiness, global truth/reliability score, punitive private-person dossier readiness or high-risk deployment approval is claimed. The final V3 hosted UI workflows did not execute because GitHub assigned no runner, so they are not represented as a green hosted run. Issue #21 remains open for a bounded non-fictional human-labelled pilot and assessor recheck. General product construction is frozen unless a real evaluator, pilot, reproducible defect or concrete route requirement earns new work.
